title: Reasonlet graph v1
description: A Mnemosyne.NET Reasonlet graph, schema version 1. This schema documents the wire format for writers that are not .NET. It accepts some documents that ReasonletGraphJson.Deserialize or ReasonletGraph.Validate() in Mnemosyne.NET.Abstractions reject, so a valid document here is not necessarily a valid graph. Rejected but not checked here: schemaVersion written as anything but the integer literal 1, such as 1.0 or 1e0; duplicate node ids; edge endpoints that do not name an existing node; duplicate edges with the same from, to and condition; duplicate member names in any object, including names that only match after unescaping, such as a and \u0061; \u escapes that leave a lone surrogate; property values nested deeper than 32 levels; and a combined size of all properties over 65536 bytes, measured as UTF-8 canonical JSON with the RFC 8785 escape set. Length limits are expressed with maxLength and count Unicode code points, as Validate does. Deserialize runs the full check. The $id is an identifier, not a URL to fetch the schema from.

schemaVersion.description: The graph format version. Must be written as the integer literal 1; 1.0 and 1e0 pass this schema but Deserialize rejects them.

nodes.description: The graph nodes. Ids must be unique, checked by Validate only.

edges.description: The directed edges. Each from and to must be a node id, and no two edges may share from, to and condition, checked by Validate only.

nonBlankString.description: Non-blank: at least one character outside the set that .NET char.IsWhiteSpace accepts. The class lists that set explicitly because ECMA-262 whitespace differs (U+0085, U+FEFF).

identifier.description: A non-blank identifier of at most 256 code points.

text.description: A non-blank text of at most 1024 code points.

optionalIdentifier.description: An optional member: an explicit null means the same as leaving it out.

optionalText.description: An optional member: an explicit null means the same as leaving it out.

optionalProperties.description: An optional member: an explicit null means the same as leaving it out.

properties.description: Extension data. Keys are namespaced with dots, for example acme.retries. Values are any JSON up to 32 levels deep, without duplicate member names, checked by Validate only.
